card.name: Words just before 'collection' or 'collect'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'that' or 'ever' where the next word could plausibly be 'collection', 'collected' or 'gathered'. It shows up in web text about archives, libraries and gathering things, and sometimes in blood-draw descriptions.

modes.label: Archive and gathering text
modes.description: A linking word or adjective in text about archives, encyclopedias or libraries where 'collection' or 'gathered' may follow.

modes.description: The word 'to' before a verb of gathering or organizing, such as drawing blood or organizing images.
